test_policy.notes: College Navigator (IPEDS fall 2024 admissions) lists SAT/ACT as 'Not considered (Test Blind)', as for the rest of the CSU. CSUSB's own CDS C7/C8 form fields conflict with that (see the stats notes), so the CSU-wide policy is used. A first-year international applicant may use an SAT English score of 550+ or an ACT English score of 22+ as proof of English only. Eligibility for foreign high school graduates is a 2.5 overall GPA.

requirements.notes: Apply through CSUApply / Cal State Apply (not the Common App); the $70 fee is non-refundable and international students are not eligible for a fee waiver (Admission FAQs). Needs a 2.5 overall GPA. Foreign high school applicants send official transcripts and diploma sealed in an envelope by the school, with certified English translations; also a passport copy and a statement of financial responsibility (bank statement / affidavit of support) plus proof of medical insurance. CDS C7: essays, recommendations and interviews are not considered.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt if a first-time freshman attended a high school in the U.S. for 3+ years or a high school where English is the principal language of instruction for 3+ years (listed countries include Antigua and Barbuda, Australia, Bahamas, Canada except Quebec/northern New Brunswick/Nunavut, Ireland, Jamaica, Kenya, Nigeria, New Zealand, South Africa, the United Kingdom and the United States). Scores must be valid within two years; TOEFL ITP is not accepted. Other accepted proofs for freshmen: iTEP 3.7, EIKEN Pre-1 (CSE 2304-3000), SAT English 550+, ACT English 22+, or completing Level 3 of CSUSB's English Language Program. Conditional admission lets academically qualified applicants below the English minimum enter the English Language Program first.

english.notes: Exams taken before Jan 21, 2026 (0-120 scale); Home Edition accepted. Graduate minimum 79.
Exams taken on or after Jan 21, 2026; the page lists 3.5 for undergraduates, 4 for graduates and 5 for post-graduate programs without naming the scale (assumed to be the new 1-6 band scale).
IELTS Academic overall; submit through the Cal State Apply e-delivery account. Graduate minimum 6.0.
Send online through your Duolingo account. Graduate minimum 105.
PTE Academic; send online through your PTE account. Graduate minimum 53.
Cambridge B2 First score of 168 for undergraduates (C1 Advanced 180 for graduates).

aid.notes: The CSUSB catalog says scholarship aid for entering students is limited and none are specifically reserved for students from another country; no international merit scholarship or tuition waiver was found for undergraduates. The CDS (H6) reports no institutional aid recipients among degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates. Conditional admission is offered: students who are academically qualified but below the English minimum attend the CSUSB English Language Program (Level 3 for undergraduates, with an accelerated one-semester Level 3 option) before starting their degree; this needs two applications (one to the International Extension Program and one through Cal State Apply).

cost.notes: From CSUSB's 2026-27 suggested international budget (undergraduate, 24 units): tuition and fees $20,359 combined, including the $471 per unit non-resident charge (stored as tuition_intl_usd; the page does not split fees out); living expenses $19,786 (stored in room_board_usd), books and supplies $880, and other = transportation $2,906 plus health insurance $1,956 plus personal $4,414. Total $50,301. Dependents need $6,000 each per academic year.
